description: This file manages Matrix client storage paths, including legacy storage migration, path resolution, and metadata handling. It interacts with the filesystem to locate, verify, and migrate storage directories and files specific to Matrix client instances.

methods.name: resolveLegacyStoragePaths
methods.description: Resolves the legacy storage and crypto paths based on environment variables and runtime configuration.

methods.name: assertLegacyMigrationAccountSelection
methods.description: Ensures the current account matches the account associated with legacy storage, throwing an error if not.

methods.name: scoreStorageRoot
methods.description: Scores a storage root directory based on the presence of specific files and directories.

methods.name: resolveStorageRootMtimeMs
methods.description: Returns the modification time of a storage root directory.

methods.name: readStoredRootMetadata
methods.description: Reads and parses metadata from a storage root directory.

methods.name: isCompatibleStorageRoot
methods.description: Checks if a storage root directory is compatible with given account and device parameters.

methods.name: resolvePreferredMatrixStorageRoot
methods.description: Selects the best storage root directory among siblings based on score and modification time.

methods.name: resolveMatrixStoragePaths
methods.description: Resolves all relevant storage paths for a Matrix account, including legacy migration handling.

methods.name: resolveMatrixStateFilePath
methods.description: Generates the full path to a specific Matrix state file within the storage directory.

methods.name: maybeMigrateLegacyStorage
methods.description: Performs migration of legacy storage artifacts to current storage paths if needed.

methods.name: moveLegacyStoragePathOrThrow
methods.description: Moves a legacy storage path to a new location, throwing an error if the target exists.

methods.name: rollbackLegacyMoves
methods.description: Attempts to revert moves made during migration if an error occurs.

methods.name: writeStorageMeta
methods.description: Writes metadata about the storage configuration to a JSON file.
